scope: Research records only; no serving source, defaults, image, weights, host settings, NewAPI or release version changed
finding: No inspected public evidence establishes a replacement runtime faster than R1.8 on the same eight-A100, original V4.1, multimodal, 1M, C32 workload. Prioritize source-compatible ports and measure them on target.

engram_attribution: No causal proof that host Engram alone explains lower A100 decode; profile host lookup, NUMA/PCIe, attention, compute, draft and communication before attribution.
